verdict.rationale: Fivetran's pricing page lists '1-minute syncs', its own feature showing sub-hour sync frequency. Nothing in the pack documents per-connection frequency settings, cron-expression scheduling, or a manual 'sync now' trigger. Connection-level re-sync is a different, adjacent capability, and the transformation scheduling belongs to another story. Missing for 10: documented per-pipeline frequency configuration, cron expression support, manual sync triggers via UI or API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I control sync frequency per pipeline — from sub-hour schedules to cron expressions and manual triggers
